meta.title: English overlay for rules/*.json (label · amount_text · summary · where · docs). Legal citations in `basis` stay in Korean (article numbers).

cash.house_flood.label: Disaster relief payment — flooded home
cash.house_flood.summary: Flat payment per household whose residence was flooded above floor level. Covers household goods.
docs: Resident registration (can be pulled by the office)

cash.house_full.label: Disaster relief payment — home destroyed/washed away
cash.house_full.summary: For a destroyed or washed-away home: 30% of recovery cost as a grant, 60–70% as a loan, remainder self-paid.
docs: Building register or proof of ownership

cash.house_half.label: Disaster relief payment — home half-destroyed
cash.house_half.summary: Half-destroyed home: 50% of the full-destruction base with the same split (30% grant · loan · self).
docs: Building register or proof of ownership

cash.tenant_subsidy.label: Tenant subsidy — destroyed/half-destroyed home
cash.tenant_subsidy.amount_text: Up to ₩6M per household (deposit or 6 months' rent)
cash.tenant_subsidy.summary: Tenants of a destroyed, half-destroyed or washed-away home receive a move-in deposit or ~6 months' rent.

cash.small_biz_stability.label: Small-business stabilization payment
cash.small_biz_stability.summary: Flat payment per flooded/damaged small business. Business registration required.

cash.small_biz_facility.label: Small-business facility recovery support
cash.small_biz_facility.amount_text: Building: 30% grant · 60% loan · 10% self / Machinery: 35% · 55% · 10% (unit costs unconfirmed)
cash.small_biz_facility.summary: New from 2025-11-27. Recovery cost for business buildings and machinery split into grant, loan and self-payment.

cash.relief_living.label: Living-stability relief (meals & living costs at temporary housing)
cash.relief_living.amount_text: Daily meal and living allowance by household size (current rates unconfirmed)
cash.relief_living.summary: For displaced households staying in temporary housing: daily meal and living allowance by number of members.
cash.relief_living.where: Community center / municipality running the shelter

cash.death_missing.label: Condolence payment — death or missing
cash.death_missing.summary: Paid to the family when a natural disaster causes death or disappearance.

cash.injury.label: Condolence payment — injury
cash.injury.summary: Paid for disaster injuries that meet a disability grade.

cash.farm_recovery.label: Crop, farmland and farm-facility recovery cost
cash.farm_recovery.amount_text: Recovery unit cost by type/area (MAFRA notice) × share — not computed
cash.farm_recovery.summary: Recovery cost (grant + loan + self) for washed-out/buried farmland, crop loss, greenhouses and barns.

heat_cold.heat_shelter.label: Use a cooling center
heat_cold.heat_shelter.summary: During heat advisories anyone can use designated cooling centers (senior centers, community centers, banks). Night/holiday centers are designated separately.
heat_cold.heat_shelter.where: Find the nearest on SafeKorea / Safety Didimdol app / community center

heat_cold.cold_shelter.label: Use a warming center
heat_cold.cold_shelter.summary: During cold-wave advisories designated warming centers are free. Emergency warming shelters (stations, terminals) are separate.
heat_cold.cold_shelter.where: SafeKorea / Safety Didimdol app / community center

heat_cold.energy_voucher.label: Energy voucher (summer & winter)
heat_cold.energy_voucher.amount_text: Annual amount by household size (2026 rates unconfirmed; 2025: 1 person ~₩295K to 4+ ~₩701K, combined)
heat_cold.energy_voucher.summary: Cooling (electricity credit) and heating (fuel) vouchers for basic-livelihood households that include elderly, disabled, infants, pregnant women or serious illness.

heat_cold.emergency_welfare_heat_cold.label: Emergency welfare (heat/cold crisis households)
heat_cold.emergency_welfare_heat_cold.amount_text: Living support by household size / monthly fuel allowance (2026 rates unconfirmed)
heat_cold.emergency_welfare_heat_cold.summary: Emergency living, fuel and medical support for households in crisis due to heat or cold; linked to appliance support.
heat_cold.emergency_welfare_heat_cold.where: Community center / Health & Welfare call center 129

heat_cold.heat_illness_care.label: Heat/cold illness response & care for vulnerable people
heat_cold.heat_illness_care.summary: During advisories: welfare check calls and home visits for elderly living alone and disabled people; ER surveillance.
heat_cold.heat_illness_care.where: Public health center / elderly care service provider / 119

heat_cold.cooling_heating_device.label: Cooling/heating appliance support for vulnerable households
heat_cold.cooling_heating_device.summary: Fans, air conditioners, heaters and insulation for low-income households; municipal and Korea Energy Foundation programs.
heat_cold.cooling_heating_device.where: Community center / Korea Energy Foundation (energy-efficiency program)
docs: Proof of basic-livelihood or near-poor status

relief_fund.house_full.label: Relief fund — home destroyed/washed away
relief_fund.house_full.summary: Donation-fund payment for households whose home was destroyed. Paid in addition to the government relief payment.
relief_fund.house_full.where: Community center (report → municipality tally → association pays)

relief_fund.house_half.label: Relief fund — home half-destroyed
relief_fund.house_half.summary: Donation-fund payment for a half-destroyed residence.

relief_fund.house_flood.label: Relief fund — flooded home
relief_fund.house_flood.summary: Donation-fund payment for a flooded residence. Tenants included.

relief_fund.house_minor_quake.label: Relief fund — minor earthquake damage
relief_fund.house_minor_quake.summary: Donation-fund payment for minor earthquake damage to a home.

relief_fund.death.label: Relief fund — death or missing
relief_fund.death.summary: Paid to the family of a person killed or missing in a natural disaster.

indirect.nhis_premium.label: Health-insurance premium reduction
indirect.nhis_premium.summary: Premiums reduced 30–50% (by damage level) for 3 months from the month after the disaster.
indirect.nhis_premium.where: National Health Insurance Service (municipality sends the victim list)
docs: Damage confirmation (usually sent by the municipality)

indirect.nhis_late_fee.label: Health-insurance late-fee waiver
indirect.nhis_late_fee.summary: No late fees on health-insurance premiums for 6 months.
docs: Damage confirmation (usually sent by the municipality)

indirect.nps_exemption.label: National-pension contribution exemption
indirect.nps_exemption.summary: Regional members may apply for up to 12 months' exemption citing disaster damage.

indirect.electricity.label: Electricity bill reduction
indirect.electricity.amount_text: Destroyed: 1 month free / damaged: 1 month 50% off
indirect.electricity.summary: Destroyed or washed-away home: one month free; half-destroyed or flooded: one month at 50%.
docs: Damage confirmation (usually sent by the municipality; submit yourself if missing)

indirect.telecom.label: Telecom bill reduction (mobile · internet)
indirect.telecom.amount_text: Mobile: one line up to ₩12,500 / VoIP 100% / broadband 50%
indirect.telecom.summary: Per household: one mobile line up to ₩12,500 off, VoIP 100% and broadband 50% off for one month.
indirect.telecom.where: Your carrier's customer center (SKT 114 / KT 100 / LGU+ 101)

indirect.citygas.label: City-gas bill reduction
indirect.citygas.summary: Flat one-month reduction by usage type and damage level.
docs: Damage confirmation (usually sent by the municipality)

indirect.district_heating.label: District-heating bill reduction
indirect.district_heating.summary: Basic-charge reduction for district-heating households by damage level.
indirect.district_heating.where: Korea District Heating Corp. or your heat supplier

indirect.local_tax.label: Local-tax reduction & deferral (property, resident, vehicle tax)
indirect.local_tax.amount_text: Reduction + deferral (up to 1 year; 2 years in special disaster zones)
indirect.local_tax.summary: Reduction and payment deferral on local taxes for damaged property; up to 2 years in special disaster zones.

indirect.national_tax.label: National-tax deadline extension & deferral
indirect.national_tax.amount_text: Extension 9 months–1 year; up to 2 years in special disaster zones
indirect.national_tax.summary: Extended filing/payment deadlines for VAT, income tax etc., and deferral of collection.
indirect.national_tax.where: Your tax office / Hometax / tax helpline 126

indirect.highschool_tuition.label: High-school tuition reduction
indirect.highschool_tuition.summary: Tuition reduced for high-school students of affected households for 6 months, up to ₩1M.
indirect.highschool_tuition.where: School administration office / provincial education office

indirect.sme_guarantee.label: Disaster special guarantee for SMEs & small businesses (lower fee)
indirect.sme_guarantee.summary: Special guarantee with fee 0.1% and 100% coverage for disaster-hit small businesses.
indirect.sme_guarantee.where: Regional credit guarantee foundation / KODIT / SEMAS

indirect.sme_emergency_loan.label: Emergency business-stability loan for small businesses
indirect.sme_emergency_loan.summary: Low-interest direct loan from SEMAS policy funds for disaster-hit small businesses.

indirect.military_postpone.label: Postponement of military-service dates
indirect.military_postpone.summary: Enlistment/call-up dates postponed for members of affected households in special disaster zones.

indirect.reserve_training_exempt.label: Reserve-forces / civil-defense training exemption
indirect.reserve_training_exempt.summary: Training exempted or deferred for members of affected households in special disaster zones.

indirect.tv_license.label: TV licence fee exemption
indirect.tv_license.summary: TV licence fee exemption for households whose home was destroyed.

indirect.water_sewage.label: Water & sewage bill reduction
indirect.water_sewage.summary: Water/sewage bills reduced for a period under municipal ordinance.

indirect.farm_loan_relief.label: Farm policy-loan deferral & interest relief
indirect.farm_loan_relief.amount_text: Repayment deferred up to 2 years · interest relief (by damage rate)
indirect.farm_loan_relief.summary: Principal deferral and interest relief on farm policy loans; disaster management loans.

indirect.student_loan_defer.label: Student-loan repayment deferral
indirect.student_loan_defer.summary: KOSAF student-loan deferral and special support for students/graduates of affected households.

indirect.emergency_welfare.label: Emergency welfare — living support
indirect.emergency_welfare.amount_text: By household size (2026 rates unconfirmed; 2025: ~₩1.87M/month for 4)
indirect.emergency_welfare.summary: Living, housing and medical support under the Emergency Welfare Act when a disaster makes living difficult (income/asset tests apply).
indirect.emergency_welfare.where: Community center / Health & Welfare call center 129

indirect.temp_housing.label: Temporary housing for displaced households (public rental · modular units)
indirect.temp_housing.summary: LH public rental units or modular housing for households whose home was destroyed or half-destroyed.
indirect.temp_housing.where: City/county/district disaster division / LH regional office

indirect.psych_support.label: Disaster mental-health support (free counselling)
indirect.psych_support.summary: Free counselling for victims and families; high-risk cases referred for treatment.
indirect.psych_support.where: Provincial disaster mental-health center (Korean Red Cross) / crisis line 1577-0199

indirect.disaster_victim_center.label: Joint disaster-victim support center (one-stop desk)
indirect.disaster_victim_center.summary: New from 2026-07-22. A whole-of-government one-stop desk set up on site for large disasters.

insurance.house_general.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — home (general)
insurance.house_general.amount_text: 55%+ of premium subsidized (up to 92% with municipal top-up)
insurance.house_general.summary: The government pays 55% or more of the premium for homeowners and tenants.
insurance.house_general.where: Insurers (DB · Hyundai · Samsung · KB · NH · Meritz · Hanwha) / community center

insurance.house_single_parent_near_poor.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — home (single-parent · near-poor)
insurance.house_single_parent_near_poor.summary: Single-parent and near-poor households get 77.5% or more of the premium.

insurance.house_basic.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — home (basic livelihood)
insurance.house_basic.summary: Basic-livelihood recipients get 86.5% or more of the premium.

insurance.house_vulnerable_zone_full.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — low-income in hazard-prone areas (full)
insurance.house_vulnerable_zone_full.summary: Low-income homes in hazard-prone areas (flood traces, landslide-prone, risk improvement districts) are fully subsidized.

insurance.greenhouse.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — greenhouses
insurance.greenhouse.summary: 70% or more of the premium for agricultural/forestry greenhouses.

insurance.small_biz.label: Storm & earthquake insurance — small-business shops & factories
insurance.small_biz.summary: 55% or more of the premium for small-business buildings, facilities and inventory.

proc.evidence.label: Secure photos and evidence
proc.evidence.summary: Before cleaning or repairs, photograph the water line, damaged parts, household goods and signage with the date visible. Keep receipts and estimates.
docs: Lease or business registration if applicable

proc.report.label: File the natural-disaster damage report (within 10 days of the disaster end)
proc.report.summary: Submit the damage report (Form 1) to the mayor/county/district office via the community center, or online at SafeKorea.
docs: Resident registration, income and family certificates are pulled by the office (§9⑤)

proc.survey.label: Municipal field survey (damage level)
proc.survey.summary: Officials (with experts if needed) visit to confirm flooding / half / full destruction and area, and register it in NDMS.

proc.certificate.label: Damage confirmation certificate issued
proc.certificate.summary: Issued by the municipality based on the survey. Common document for indirect support (health insurance, electricity, telecom, tax).

proc.payment.label: Relief payment and relief fund paid
proc.payment.summary: Paid to your account once the recovery plan is confirmed. The relief fund is paid separately by Hope Bridge from the municipal list. Flat items (e.g. flooding) may be pre-paid.
docs: Copy of your bankbook (submitted with the report)
proc.payment.typical_days: 2–6 weeks after report (1–2 weeks pre-payment in large disasters)

proc.appeal.label: Objection / re-survey request
proc.appeal.summary: If you disagree with the damage level or exclusion, request a re-survey or file an objection. Administrative appeal or lawsuit within 90 days of notice.
proc.appeal.where: District disaster division → administrative appeals commission / administrative court
